newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar ends off highs, March secures $300.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar ends off highs, March secures $300.

text.p: London white futures slipped off their peaks after a steep rally on Friday, but the March contract managed to secure a close at $300, traders said.
A bout of mixed buying, helped by firm demand in the physical market for whites, steered March to an intraday high of $302.00. It had been whipping under $300 this month.
But Friday's gains prompted some players to take profits, dragging the contract lower at the close. The gains on March totalled $1.90 on the day.
